channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Chicago Woman Sues Border Patrol After Being Shot Five Times
item.description: A Chicago woman who was shot five times by a Border Patrol agent has filed a federal lawsuit against the U.S. government. The incident involved a Border Patrol officer, and the lawsuit seeks damages for the shooting. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Burglars cut open an ATM in Shamshabad using a gas cutter and stole approximately Rs 30 to Rs 32 lakh in cash. The incident occurred early on Tuesday, October 6. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
